title: Rotation and Key setup at level 27
caption: You asked for a Simple mode. It's the Rotation section at the top of Build, always open; the keys and macro are in the Key setup fold under it (one view).

title: Key setup: icons, your keys, the macro
caption: At level 27 each key box is the skill's icon (name on hover or tap), you can set your own key per stack, and the macro shows as its steps.

title: A key box's name on a phone
caption: At level 27 on a 360 px phone, tapping a box in the right-hand column shows its name, key and row, kept inside the screen.
